source_text: Δευτέρα δὲ ἐντολὴ τῆς διδαχῆς: οὐ φονεύσεις, οὐ μοιχεύσεις, οὐ παιδοφθορήσεις, οὐ πορνεύσεις, οὐ κλέψεις, οὐ μαγεύσεις, οὐ φαρμακεύσεις, οὐ φονεύσεις τέκνον ἐν φθορᾷ, οὐδὲ γεννηθὲν ἀποκτενεῖς, οὐκ ἐπιθυμήσεις τὰ τοῦ πλησίον. οὐκ ἐπιορκήσεις, οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις, οὐ κακολογήσεις, οὐ μνησικακήσεις. οὐκ ἔσῃ διγνώμων οὐδὲ δίγλωσσος: παγὶς γὰρ θανάτου ἡ διγλωσσία. οὐκ ἔσται ὁ λόγος σου ψευδής, οὐ κενός, ἀλλὰ μεμεστωμένος πράξει, οὐκ ἔσῃ πλεονέκτης οὐδὲ ἅρπαξ οὐδὲ ὑποκριτὴς οὐδὲ κακοήθης οὐδὲ ὑπερήφανος. οὐ λήψῃ βουλὴν πονηρὰν κατὰ τοῦ πλησίον σου. οὐ μισήσεις πάντα ἄνθρωπον, ἀλλὰ οὓς μὲν ἐλέγξεις, περὶ δὲ ὦν προσεύξῃ, οὓς δὲ ἀγαπήσεις ὑπὲρ τὴν ψυχήν σου.
pass_a_gloss: Second the commandment of the teaching: you will not kill, you will not commit adultery, you will not corrupt children, you will not fornicate, you will not steal, you will not practice magic, you will not use potions, you will not kill a child by abortion, nor will you kill a newborn, you will not covet the things of your neighbor. You will not swear falsely, you will not give false testimony, you will not speak evil, you will not hold a grudge. You will not be double-minded nor double-tongued: for double-tonguedness is a snare of death. Your word will not be false, nor empty, but filled with action, you will not be greedy nor a robber nor a hypocrite nor evil-minded nor arrogant. You will not take evil counsel against your neighbor. You will not hate every person, but those you will rebuke, about whom you will pray, those you will love more than your own soul.

pass_b_english: The second commandment of the Teaching is this: you must not murder, you must not commit adultery, you must not corrupt children, you must not engage in sexual immorality, you must not steal, you must not practice magic, you must not use potions, you must not kill a child by abortion, nor may you kill a newborn, and you must not covet anything that belongs to your neighbor. You must not swear falsely, you must not give false testimony, you must not speak evil of anyone, and you must not hold a grudge. Do not be double‑minded or double‑tongued, because a double tongue is a snare of death. Let your word not be false or empty, but filled with action. You must not be greedy, or a robber, or a hypocrite, or evil‑minded, or arrogant. You must not plot evil against your neighbor. You must not hate every person; instead, rebuke some, pray for others, and love some more than your own life.
